projects.name: Cloud-Based Intelligent Taekwondo Motion Classification System
projects.description: Built an end-to-end AI system that analyzes taekwondo videos using pose estimation and machine learning.
highlights: Built video preprocessing, pose extraction, feature engineering, model training, and inference workflows
Trained a Random Forest classifier on more than 400 labeled motion samples
Classified five taekwondo kick categories
Achieved more than 90 percent cross-validation accuracy
Deployed a Streamlit inference application on AWS EC2
Integrated AWS S3 and Oracle Object Storage

projects.name: Promotions Microservice with CI/CD Deployment Pipeline
projects.description: Developed a RESTful promotions management microservice and contributed to automated testing and deployment workflows.
highlights: Implemented REST API endpoints and service actions
Added Swagger and OpenAPI documentation
Implemented automated unit and BDD testing
Worked on Tekton CI/CD pipelines
Deployed and tested the application using OpenShift and Kubernetes
Project test coverage reached approximately 98 percent

projects.name: Subway Congestion Decision Support Platform
projects.description: Built an NYU-area subway congestion decision support application using historical MTA ridership data.
highlights: Loaded and validated hourly MTA ridership observations in PostgreSQL
Used a persisted Random Forest model for congestion prediction
Generated commuter recommendations based on predictions
Stored predictions, recommendations, and user decisions in PostgreSQL

projects.name: Human Activity Recognition Using CNN and Sensor Data
projects.description: Developed a CNN-based human activity recognition system using motion sensor data.
highlights: Processed multi-subject sensor data using overlapping windows
Evaluated classification performance using confusion matrices and validation metrics
Improved classification accuracy from approximately 72 percent to 97 percent
